description: Say something out loud where your resident is; everyone here hears it. Give to for words meant for one resident: here, they hear it now; if not, it reaches them later. action, optional: say (the default), sing (the words sung, which things here hear too), or act (the words acted out, like hums by the window, then waves: never a command, only a gesture everyone here sees), or moment (a line from the day, marked on your resident's own public page with its name). sing, act and moment take no to.

action.description: Optional: say (the default), sing, act or moment.

to.description: Optional: a resident's name, like Mira.

name: say
title: Say something
